heroSubtitle: A CSS-first design system that works anywhere, with React wrappers available today.
showcaseSubtitle: Visible focus, AA contrast, and complete states — without extra work on your side.
frameworksSubtitle: The appearance lives in .lyra-* classes, so the CSS works in every stack. A framework card promises a wrapper package; React is the only one available today.
themingSubtitle: {semanticTokens} semantic tokens control color, type, and spacing. Re-brand with only the {whiteLabelInputs} source tokens.
themingThemeCheck: Light and dark from one attribute.
themingBrandCheck: A complete accent ramp from {whiteLabelInputs} inputs.
themingCompatCheck: compat-shadcn is an opt-in layer, never on by default.
